Trigger tab ⚡ local only

Four adapter cards that let you scrape, preview, and push course data updates. This tab is hidden on HTTPS (GitHub Pages) because all adapter operations call http://localhost:3333 — a browser will block HTTP requests from an HTTPS page as mixed content. Run npm run dev to start both Vite on :5173 and the backend server on :3333.

Requires
npm run dev running locally (starts catalog-check-server.js on :3333)
Hidden on
HTTPS (GitHub Pages) — mixed-content protection blocks HTTP calls to :3333
Logs to
public/northeastern/change-log.json — every successful ⚡ Run creates a manual-trigger entry

Adapter cards

adapter
Term Availability
Queries Banner SSB for the last 3 academic years. Writes term-history.json — which terms each course was offered in.
adapter
Course Catalog
Scrapes catalog.northeastern.edu. Two modes: full scrape of all subjects, or round-robin rotation (one subject per run). Writes catalog-courses.json.
adapter
Major Requirements
Scrapes undergraduate degree requirements from the catalog. Writes parsed.initial.json files in src/data/majors/. ~45 min, rate-limited at 600 ms/request.
adapter
NUPath Attributes
Fetches NUPath attributes from Tableau (authoritative Registrar source). Falls back to catalog HTML. Writes all-courses.json then re-applies patches.

Three buttons per card

ButtonWhat it doesWrites files?
▷ PreviewRuns the script with no --write flag. Output streams live in the SSE log panel. Nothing is written to disk.No
⚡ Run locallyRuns the script with --write. Writes output files and appends a manual-trigger entry to change-log.json.Yes
↺ GitHub ActionsTriggers the corresponding GitHub Actions workflow via the API (requires a fine-grained PAT configured in dev.html). Useful when you want the update to run on GitHub's servers rather than your machine.On GH CI

SSE log stream

When ▷ Preview or ⚡ Run locally is clicked, the server spawns the script as a child process and streams stdout/stderr back as Server-Sent Events. The portal renders these lines in a scrollable log panel in real time. A final done event carries the exit code.

sequenceDiagram participant You participant Portal as Browser participant Server as :3333 participant Script as Node script You->>Portal: click ⚡ Run locally Portal->>Server: GET /run?id=catalog&write=1 Server->>Script: spawn scrape-catalog.js --write loop stdout/stderr lines Script-->>Server: line Server-->>Portal: SSE {type:"log"|"err", msg} Portal-->>You: line appended to log panel end Script-->>Server: exit(0) Server-->>Portal: SSE {type:"done", code:0} Server->>Server: append manual-trigger → change-log.json

Review & Push

Inside the Trigger tab. Calls GET /git-status first to show a diff of all tracked data files. If there are changes, POST /git-push commits and pushes to main. GitHub Actions deploys in ~2 minutes. See dev-portal/ for the full sequence diagram.
